direction: Grounded alien fauna with connected load-bearing anatomy, overlapping weathered carapaces, recessed sensory organs and dry fibrous tissue
approval: Direction selected within the user's requested modeling redesign; browser review required before publication
world_scale: 18 world units per meter; Y up, -Z forward
provenance: Original code-authored anatomy. Main game reuses existing Poly Haven CC0 rock color-height and roughness scans from assets/canyon-v2; fallback maps are original deterministic texture data. No new downloads.

textures.filtering: repeat wrapping, linear magnification, trilinear mipmaps
textures.scope: Shared by all four species, both LODs and the boundary guardian
textures.runtime: configureFaunaSurface uses shared existing 2048px rock-diff-height.png (sRGB RGB, alpha height), rock-rough.jpg (linear); physically scaled UVs at 40worldunits/tile, desaturated scan variation with retained vertex tint, alpha bumpScale1.3, roughnessfloor0.74.
textures.fallback: Three original 512px maps support isolated offline geometry review without the world asset loader.

species.name: Hunter
species.changes: Connected elongated thorax and abdomen with integrated segmented carapace, thicker proximal leg links, low recessed head and serrated hooked mandibles; tall back spikes removed

species.name: Charger
species.changes: Broad closed low carapace and shoulder mass, compact snout, small tapered forward tusks, armored three-toed feet and lateral respiratory slots; tall paired horns and bright body beads removed

species.name: Spore carrier
species.changes: Three elongated opaque folded dorsal chambers under a protective carapace, small slit vents, recessed mortar membrane; five translucent glowing balloon sacs removed

species.name: Brood lord
species.changes: Connected broad rib cage and pelvic mass, robust arm attachments, long low head and tapered articulated scythes; floating breastplates, tall crown spikes and glowing rib stripes removed

preserved: All attack emitters and claw sockets
Shared immutable geometry and private skeletons
geometry_revision: Final visual-review tune: continuous closed carapace forms final exposed body/head surface with embedded growth seams at 7% profile relief; no overlapping broad dorsal/forehead cards. UV size increased to40worldunits per tile and actual scanned relief/albedo calibrated from decoded pixel quantiles.
